subject: Agriculture
title: How Rocks Become Soil
description: A quick win: understand How Rocks Become Soil.

hook.text: Every soil on Earth started as rock. The journey from boulder to farmable ground takes millennia.

buildup.text: Physical weathering cracks rocks—freeze-thaw cycles, root pressure, and grinding by glaciers.

discovery.text: Chemical weathering dissolves minerals. Rainwater, slightly acidic from CO2, eats granite over centuries.

twist.text: The type of parent rock determines the soil's mineral content. Limestone gives alkaline soil; granite gives acidic.

climax.text: Biological weathering adds the final ingredient—lichens, roots, and microbes break rock into living soil.

punchline.text: Soil is rock—just very, very patient rock.

quiz.question: What role does chemical weathering play in soil formation?
options: It dissolves minerals from rock using acidic rainwater
